prerequisites: Knowledge from basic mechanical engineering subjects

learning_outcomes.text: The practical phase should introduce students to professional activities in mechanical engineering through concrete tasks and practical collaboration in companies or professional practice corresponding to the study goal. It should particularly serve to apply the knowledge and skills acquired in previous studies outside the university and to reflect on and evaluate the experiences gained in practical work.
Students are able to work in an industrial or economic context and integrate into corresponding organizational structures.

syllabus_topics: Subject-specific knowledge and procedures: Dependent on the project worked on during the practical phase. The student's activity is supervised by the university during the practical phase.
Ability to adapt to new environments
Ability to integrate into work processes
assessment_rules: The practical phase is not graded. Credit points are awarded upon successful presentation and submission of documentation. Prerequisites for participation in the examination are specified in the BPO.
